source_observations.observation: At original 1600x1600 resolution the lower wrapped shaft (normalized .31,.79), upper wooden shaft (.48,.41), metal head (.67,.30) and sharpened outer blade (.73,.28) are all opaque; original paid grip (.15,.85) and blade tip (.88,.28) are transparent background, not valid contacts.

At original 1222x1287 resolution the character's anatomical right hand at the viewer's left holds the low shaft and his left hand at the viewer's right holds a separate higher region; he truly carries the axe with two hands.

resolved_uncertainties.original: The exact grip points for the secondary hand in the 'carry' mode are inferred from the character's pose in IMAGE 2, as the isolated axe in IMAGE 1 does not explicitly define multiple grip regions beyond the primary lower grip.
resolved_uncertainties.resolution: The second grip is established directly by the original character image, not inferred solely from the isolated axe. The independent review places both grip centers inside visibly solid, well-separated sections of the isolated wooden shaft and keeps the original paid answer unchanged.

characterization.object_function: A two-handed cutting axe: the sharp outward metal blade chops a target while both hands hold separated regions of its wooden shaft.
characterization.object_evidence: IMAGE 1 shows a long wooden axe haft with reinforced rings and leather near the butt; an unmistakable wide metal chopping head extends laterally from the upper end. IMAGE 2 explicitly shows the intended character grasping this haft with two separated hands.

features.function: Sharpened outward-facing cutting edge of the axe head
features.direction_semantics: From the body of the metal head outward toward its visible sharp curved blade edge, not toward the flat poll or down the handle.
features.evidence: IMAGE 1 exposes the broad dark metal head and its pale sharp curved outer edge; IMAGE 2 shows this blade at the far end from both hands.

grips.surface: Leather-wrapped lower wooden shaft, clear of the blade
grips.evidence: IMAGE 1 visibly exposes this wrapped grip on the wooden shaft; IMAGE 2 shows the character's anatomical right palm clasping the lower part near the butt.

grips.surface: Bare upper-middle wooden shaft, clear of the head and its sharp edge
grips.evidence: IMAGE 1 shows uninterrupted wooden haft here; IMAGE 2 shows the anatomical left palm grasping a distinct higher section of the shaft.

modes.action_intent: Carrying the axe in a relaxed manner.
modes.evidence: The original character IMAGE 2 visibly has two hands on the haft: his anatomical right grips the lower segment and his left grips a separate segment closer to the axe head.
The original character explicitly demonstrates two distinct grasp regions; the metal axe edge is the chopping feature, while axe_chop is only a Mixamo candidate pending joint QA.

characterization.explanation: Both source images directly demonstrate distinct lower and upper wooden shaft handholds and the axe head's sharpened outward edge. The character has two hands on the shaft. This reviewed image-space characterization does not assert that the Mixamo clip physically fits until 3D joint QA.
